name: Stagwolf Alpha
description: An enormous scarred Stagwolf with towering antlers that directs the pack through growls, posture, and instinctive hunting signals.

abilities.name: Alpha of the Pack
abilities.description: Other Stagwolves within Close range gain +1 to their attack rolls. This ends when the Alpha is defeated.

abilities.name: Hunting Cry
abilities.description: When the Alpha is spotlighted, mark a Stress to also spotlight up to two Stagwolves within Close range, one at a time. Each can move and take an action.

abilities.name: Great Antler Charge
abilities.description: Move from within Close range into Melee range of a target and make an attack. On a success, deal 1d12+5 physical damage and knock them back to Very Close range. If they mark HP, they also become temporarily Vulnerable.

abilities.name: Cull the Weak
abilities.description: Move from within Close range into Melee range of a target and make an attack. On a success, deal 1d12+5 physical damage and knock them back to Very Close range. If they mark HP, they also become temporarily Vulnerable.
